name: Madrid Games Week
blurb: Madrid's former consumer video game expo at IFEMA; paused since the 2019 edition and not on IFEMA's current events calendar.
notes: madridgamesweek.com no longer resolves (net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED, and ECONNREFUSED/EAI_AGAIN from a second network, tried 2026-10-05); replaced the url with IFEMA's own page about the brand, which is reachable. Rendering IFEMA's live videojuegos calendar (ifema.es/calendario/videojuegos, fetched 2026-10-05) returns only one upcoming event, 'Madhorror' (30/10/26-02/11/26) — Madrid Games Week itself is not listed. Web search indicates the fair ran yearly 2013-2019, had its 2020 edition cancelled (IFEMA/AEVI, COVID-19) and has not been confirmed to run since; a press piece from June 2024 describes Madrid's big game/comic fairs as gone. Recorded as inactive (on extended hiatus) rather than 'nothing announced yet'; re-check if IFEMA's calendar adds a listing.
